description_en: Queries the Diversion from Origin Server configurations of one or more Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instances
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防（中国内地）实例的近源流量压制配置
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-block-status --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-zvp2eibz0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBlockStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
